item.title: Best Guns in the Modern Warfare 4 Beta
item.description: The best guns in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 are exactly what you should be using if you want to be part of the meta right now. This is one of the best Call of Duty multiplayer experiences in a long time, and with a vast array of guns to choose from, you can dominate the skill-based matchmaking and improve your kill-death ratio.

item.title: BioWare Co-Founder Breaks Down the Problem With AI in Game Development Perfectly
item.description: When Electronic Arts decided to shutter legendary RPG studio BioWare on Oct. 21, Greg Zeschuk, one of BioWare's co-founders alongside Ray Muzyka and Augustine Yip, found out through a flurry of text messages. In an interview with 80 Level , Zeschuk revealed that shortly after the news broke and he went home, his feelings about the closure were fairly muted.

item.title: Game Pass Just Finally Got One of the Best Horror Games in Years
item.description: If you were to try to pick the best horror game of the 2020s so far, you’d have a very long list to choose from. Between multiple Resident Evil games, a successful revival of the Silent Hill franchise, and a slew of landmark indies like Signalis , the horror genre has been in a true renaissance over the past six years. The one game that sticks with me more than anything, though, is a three-hour psychological horror experience set on a stranded spaceship: developer Wrong Organ’s distressing Mouthwashing .

item.title: 'Celeste' and 'Towerfall' Delisted From Xbox as Dev Joins Boycott
item.description: Celeste and Towerfall are no longer on Xbox. Developer Maddy Thorson has explained why in a social media post: to support the ongoing pro-Palestinian Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions (BDS) movement against Microsoft. Thorson, who led development of both titles at Maddy Makes Games, confirmed in a post on Bluesky that her studio delisted both games from the platform.

item.title: The 'Zelda' Switch 2 Console Release Is A Confirmed Disaster For Some
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 's special edition Nintendo Switch 2 console officially releases today, Oct. 29. But the launch is not going as smoothly as planned. Fans hoping to purchase the golden console without a pre-order were already expecting to be disappointed, based on how quickly it kept selling out online ahead of its debut. Yet to everyone's surprise, even people who secured a Zelda Switch 2 pre-order are encountering problems at major retailers.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda Was Always Meant To Be Passed Down
item.description: In the lead-up to the Ocarina of Time ’s Switch 2 remake , I’ve spent a lot of time trying to nail down what makes the Legend of Zelda series so special. You could chalk a lot of its success up to pure design, as Nintendo has hammered out how to create a grand adventure game, whether it's working with pixels or an enormous 3D world. But any technical explanation for Zelda’s enduring success feels too cold and mechanical for a series that radiates warmth and joy; it simply doesn’t communicate how it feels to get lost in a Zelda game.

item.title: Spider-Man’s Most Controversial Story Officially Set to Be Undone After Almost Two Decades
item.description: In 2007, much to the chagrin of comics readers everywhere, Peter Parker made a deal with the demon Mephisto that changed reality in the story One More Day . Nearly twenty years later, that deal is still in effect and has been the elephant in the room in almost every Spider-Man story told since. You'd be hard-pressed to find a more universally hated comic story. Those dark days may finally be over.

item.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave Actor on Dietrich and Fabio: ‘His First Real Love’
item.description: With a sprawling cast of more than 60 playable characters, Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave is positively stuffed with dramatic moments and unexpected plot twists. And perhaps the very best of them comes in the final chapter of Dietrich ’s Part One route, as the battle-loving warrior faces his most daunting enemy yet.

item.title: Nintendo Restocks Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 Console
item.description: Nintendo restocked its in-demand The Legend of Zelda – 40th Anniversary Edition Switch 2 hardware , with new availability from the company's own online store going online on Thursday. Nintendo's website is getting hammered under extreme demand, with stock going in and out of availability. Shortly after Nintendo announced renewed availability, the Nintendo Store showed the console as out of stock.
